details: Wheelchair-Accessible Entrance: Main entry points and outer courtyards feature ramp access suitable for personal wheelchairs and walking aids.
Senior Dropping & Parking Zone: Dedicated drop-off points near the main entrance gate minimize walking distance for elderly devotees.
Seating and Rest Areas: Shaded seating and stone benches are positioned across the courtyard for senior citizens to rest between rituals.
Public Restrooms: On-site basic toilet facilities are available near the outer complex.
Special Express Queue (₹50 / ₹100): Senior citizens can utilize the paid express ticket lines to bypass general queues and complete darshan in 15–30 minutes.
